description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingQueryCommand' within the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.query'. The interface extends another interface 'ThingCommand' and provides a default method to retrieve selected fields to include in JSON output, along with overridden methods for setting headers and retrieving command category.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing JsonFieldSelector specifying which fields to include in the JSON representation of the entity.
